## Recommendation
Keep the **hybrid** structure: Claude Code plugin + pip-installable Python library. It aligns with your external dependency (claude-chain-miner), eliminates tombstone risks via workflow discipline, and positions the GitHub repo as usable OSS—others can `pip install git+https://github.com/EndUser123/search-research.git` or install as a plugin. [github](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/plugins/README.md)
## Tradeoffs
| Aspect | Hybrid Pros/Cons | Plugin-Only | Package-Only |
|--------|------------------|-------------|--------------|
| **Your Workflow** | CLI via pip works; chain-miner unbroken (migrate if drop). Minor plugin violations waived. | No CLI/pip; fix chain-miner (~30s sys.path change). Cleanest plugin compliance. [code.claude](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference) | No plugin (lose commands/agents/hooks). CLI only. |
| **Tombstones** | package-dir hides deletions (root cause: staging deletes pre-import check). Guard hook mitigates post-add. [code.claude](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins) | Same risk (direct imports fail on missing files). | Same risk. |
| **GitHub Appeal** | Looks professional/dual-use (pip + plugin). Common in examples. [github](https://github.com/MagnivOrg/promptlayer-claude-plugins/blob/master/pyproject.toml) | Pure plugin; niche audience. | Standard PyPI; broad but no Claude integration. |
| **Maintenance** | .gitready exceptions for pyproject.toml/src/.claude/. Dual manifests. | Zero exceptions; drop pyproject.toml, legacy src/. | Drop plugin dirs; simplify. |

**Key Fact**: Tombstones stem from git staging deletes before import resolution—not package-dir (Python fails regardless). Fix: Enhance PreToolUse hook for import validation (scan modified files' imports vs disk/git index). [code.claude](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins)
## Next Steps
1. Commit staged changes (safe: backup exists).
2. Test chain-miner post-commit.
3. Add hook: Parse imports in edited files, verify targets exist (disk or staged).
4. Publish to GitHub (--publish flag next run).
5. Document dual-use in README: "pip install -e . for CLI; claude plugins install . for integration." [code.claude](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces)

Confidence: High—hybrid matches real repos (e.g., promptlayer-claude-plugins has pyproject.toml). No data conflicts; plugin docs silent on packages (allows hybrids). [github](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/plugins/README.md)
